provider_name.description: Configured OAuth provider name used to build a legacy display fallback.

account_purpose.description: Effective connected-account capability derived from the returned scopes. The unknown value is used only when no Drive or YouTube capability is present.

display_name.description: Resolved operator-facing name. A configured account label takes precedence; legacy rows use the provider name plus a stable short account reference so multiple accounts remain distinguishable.

refresh_token_updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the stored OAuth refresh token was first registered or replaced. Legacy accounts without recorded history return an empty string.

access_token_refreshed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the short-lived OAuth access token was last refreshed automatically. The access token itself is never returned or persisted.

access_token_refresh_attempted_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when automatic access-token refresh was last attempted. Legacy accounts without recorded history return an empty string.

access_token_refresh_failed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the active automatic refresh failure. It is empty after a successful refresh or when no failure is recorded.

access_token_refresh_failure_code.description: Bounded non-secret operational failure class. Provider response bodies, error descriptions, and tokens are never returned.

access_token_refresh_relink_required.description: True only when the recorded automatic refresh failure requires reconnecting this existing OAuth account; reconnecting retains the account ID and its references.
